decks.notes: This deck focuses on casting cheap spells with cascade effects to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creatures and instant/sorcery spells. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck can cascade into powerful threats like Crashing Footfalls and Bonecrusher Giant while disrupting the opponent with counterspells like Force of Negation. The mana base is designed to support the cascade mechanic while still providing access to all necessary colors. Overall, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and maintain board presence through aggressive plays.

The main goal of this deck is to quickly and efficiently cast Cascade spells to overwhelm the opponent with a constant stream of threats. By using cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cascade into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Fury, the deck aims to put immense pressure on the opponent early in the game. Additionally, cards like Subtlety and Brazen Borrower provide interaction and disruption to control the board and protect your own threats, allowing for a fast and aggressive playstyle that can quickly close out games.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly cycle through cheap creatures such as Striped Riverwinder and Street Wraith, and then use cards like Grief to disrupt the opponent's hand. By cascading into Living End with cards like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent, the deck can then clear the board of all creatures and bring back all cycled creatures to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes control elements like Force of Negation to protect the combo. The key strategy is to set up a powerful Living End play while controlling the game with disruption.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a variety of spells and abilities to manage the opponent's threats while gradually building up to generate value and advantage. It includes a mix of removal, counterspells, card draw, and versatile creatures to maintain board control and outvalue the opponent. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional value through blinking permanents. The deck also includes powerful lands to support its strategy and enable consistency in its mana base.

The deck focuses on accelerating mana production and deploying powerful land-based combo pieces to put immense pressure on the opponent quickly. By utilizing cards like Amulet of Vigor and Primeval Titan, the deck aims to generate explosive plays that can overwhelm the opponent in a short amount of time. The inclusion of Urza's Saga provides additional versatility and consistency to the deck's strategy, while maintaining a balance between ramp and combo pieces. Overall, the deck's strength lies in its ability to assemble its combo pieces efficiently and efficiently execute its game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing Death's Shadow as a powerful creature that grows stronger as the player's life total decreases. It includes multiple ways to lower their own life total quickly, such as Thoughtseize and Unholy Heat, in order to pump up Death's Shadow to become a major threat on the battlefield. The deck also includes disruptive elements like discard spells and removal to control the board while also providing card advantage through Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration. This aggressive strategy aims to quickly overwhelm opponents and secure a victory.

The main idea of this deck is to utilize the card Glimpse of Tomorrow to set up a powerful combo by putting key creatures into play, such as Omnath, Locus of Creation, Wavesifter, and Risen Reef. This combo can generate a large amount of value and potentially overwhelm the opponent quickly. The deck also includes cards like Fury, Endurance, and Shardless Agent to provide additional support and disruption. Overall, the goal is to efficiently set up and execute a game-winning sequence of plays using the Glimpse of Tomorrow combo.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly and efficiently to cheat out powerful threats like Primeval Titan. It utilizes the Amulet of Vigor to untap lands for explosive plays and combines the lands with powerful utility lands like Urza's Saga and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle for additional value. The deck also includes various ways to tutor up key combo pieces like Summoner's Pact and Tolaria West. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats and synergies.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly and using various artifacts to fuel combos, with an emphasis on utilizing Underworld Breach to repeatedly cast spells from the graveyard. It aims to quickly assemble key pieces such as Grinding Station and Mishra's Bauble to generate infinite loops and win the game through either milling the opponent's library or dealing lethal damage with Grapeshot. The deck also utilizes cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to generate value and provide additional combo enablers.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively attack the opponent with low-cost, high damage creatures such as Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, while also utilizing burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Searing Blaze to continuously apply pressure and deal direct damage to the opponent. The inclusion of powerful spell cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel and Boros Charm helps to further punish the opponent for playing spells and maintain tempo advantage. The deck aims to swiftly defeat the opponent before they can stabilize and mount a comeback.

This deck focuses on assembling the combo of Colossus Hammer with Puresteel Paladin and Sigarda's Aid to quickly equip the hammer to a creature, usually Ornithopter or Gingerbrute, for a powerful and fast win. The deck is supported by cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Steelshaper's Gift to tutor for key pieces, as well as protection from cards like Giver of Runes and Esper Sentinel. Urza's Saga helps to find key artifacts like Colossus Hammer, while Inkmoth Nexus provides an alternative win condition through infect damage. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly with its powerful combo pieces.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on sacrificing creatures for value and dealing damage to the opponent quickly. By utilizing cards like Goblin Bombardment and Mayhem Devil, the deck can control the board while still attacking aggressively with cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also includes disruption elements like Grief and Dauthi Voidwalker to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Village Rites and Seasoned Pyromancer allow for card advantage and keeping the pressure on the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and disruption.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, while utilizing efficient spells like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell to control the board. It also utilizes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Ledger Shredder to set up card advantage and manipulate the opponent's deck. The key strategy is to maintain pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan, ultimately leading to a quick victory through a combination of aggressive creatures and control elements.

This deck revolves around disrupting your opponent's game plan by utilizing land destruction and powerful planeswalkers. By using cards like Pillage, Blood Moon, and Karn, the Great Creator, you can control the board and deny your opponent resources. Utopia Sprawl and Arbor Elf help ramp up your mana quickly, allowing you to play your threats ahead of schedule. Cards like Chandra, Torch of Defiance and Klothys, God of Destiny provide additional removal and resilience against more aggressive opponents. Overall, the deck seeks to dominate the game through a combination of control elements and efficient threats.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a combination of powerful elemental creatures and spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. With cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Teferi, Time Raveler, the deck aims to maintain board control while generating value from elemental synergies. By leveraging cards like Ephemerate and Risen Reef, the deck can outvalue the opponent over time. Additionally, the inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for extra value by blinking permanents for additional triggers and effects. Overall, the deck aims to outlast the opponent through efficient control and elemental synergies.
